name: Scalefusion
summary: Scalefusion manages Android, Apple, Windows, macOS, Linux and ChromeOS devices. Its four UEM plans cost $2 to $6 per device a month, billed annually only, with a 10-device minimum and a 14-day trial. Features such as OS patch management and live location tracking sit on the higher plans.

facts.text: Scalefusion links to an Apple Business or School Manager account with a server token, syncs ADE devices and enforces supervision and automatic enrollment when devices are unboxed or factory reset.
Password policies are applied by publishing them to selected device profiles, and profile-level policies override global settings.
The device actions page lists Lock/Unlock, Lock Screen and Reset Device, which factory resets the device.
Remote factory reset of a Mac works on Apple Silicon and T2 Macs running macOS 12 or later, while older Intel Macs need a six-digit Mac PIN.
The pricing page says all plans are billed annually only, and that a minimum of 10 total devices is required.
The footer of the security page states ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification and SOC-2 Type-2 compliance.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Billed annually at $24 per device. 1 administrator

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Billed annually at $42 per device. Adds BYOD and Apple User Enrollment, 5 administrators

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Billed annually at $60 per device. Adds LDAP, Windows Autopilot, OS update and patch management, 10 administrators

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Billed annually at $72 per device. Adds maker-checker approval, live location tracking, webhooks, 25 administrators

hiddenCosts: All plans are billed annually only, with no monthly option.
The page requires a minimum of 10 total devices.
Secure web gateway and vulnerability management add $2 per device a month each, and the Veltar bundle adds $4.
Conditional SSO sits in the separate Access Pro product at $5 per device a month.
